messages:
Maria (CSM): Kicking off the seed program seat allocation for Solstice — quick check: do we want 5 active seats + 2 observer seats or 6 active?
Diego (RevOps): I'd recommend 5 active + 2 observers for now. Keeps costs predictable and leaves room for stretch.
Sophie (Solutions): +1 on 5/2. We should reserve an extra sandbox seat for SRE testing during onboarding.
Alex (PM): Agree. Can we get that reflected in the sheet? Link: https://docs.google.com/example-sheet (will share perm)
Maria (CSM): I'll update the sheet. Proposed enablement cadence: 45-min kickoff, then weekly 30-min check-ins for first 3 weeks, then biweekly. Thoughts?
Linh (Customer): That works for us. Can we also add a short async feedback form after each check-in?
Sophie (Solutions): Yes — we'll send a 3-question form. Template:
```
1) What worked?
2) Top blocker?
3) Priority for next week (1-3)
```
Maria (CSM): Perfect. Diego — any billing/renewal implications if they expand before EOW?
Diego (RevOps): If they expand beyond committed seats before the quarter ends, we flag as potential renewal risk/opportunity and loop sales. I'll add an "expansion watch" tag in Gainsight.
Alex (PM): Can product join the first kickoff to capture early feedback on model latency? @Diego can you book a session next Tue 10am PT?
Diego (RevOps): Booking now. ops-bot: calendar invite sent to attendees.
ops-bot: Invite: Seed Program Kickoff — Solstice — Tue 10:00 PT — Calendar event created.
Maria (CSM): Thanks — I'll draft the checklist for onboarding and include rollout fallback (pin older model) in case of perf regressions.
Sophie (Solutions): Also adding a short eval prompt set to monitor quality drift during the seed week.
Linh (Customer): Great. One ask — can we get a weekly digest for leaders (CTO/Head of ML) summarizing issues and wins?
Maria (CSM): Yes — I'll produce a one-page digest every Friday. Using this channel for day-to-day updates.
Alex (PM): Closing the loop: seat plan final = 5 active + 2 observers + 1 sandbox. Next steps: sheet update, invite, feedback form, digest. :rocket:
